title: Maui Diamond Sea Sports

services.name: Sunset Whale Watch
services.desc: Whales and sunsets - a Maui must-do. From January through March, the Maui Diamond transforms from a dive boat into your front-row seat for one of the ocean’s greatest shows. Join us for an intimate Maui sunset whale watch, where humpback whales breach and play against the golden backdrop of a Hawaiian sunset. Unlike larger tour boats, we keep our whale watch trips to just 20 guests maximum - even though our 46-foot boat is rated for 49 passengers. That means more space to move around, unobstructed views, and a relaxed, personal experience. We usually return to the harbor just after sunset, making this the perfect way to wrap up your Maui day. With your own 46’ Newton dive boat, licensed captain, and professional crew, you’ll enjoy a fully customized experience in comfort and style. Let’s make some waves - your way.
